sentences.en: I've always wanted to go to Australia with my family.
sentences.zh: 我一直梦想和家人一起去澳大利亚。

sentences.en: Susan and Bob have flown from London to Sydney, Australia.
sentences.zh: 苏珊和鲍勃从伦敦飞到了澳大利亚悉尼。

sentences.en: Where do you place the stress in the word "Australia"?
sentences.zh: 你在单词‘Australia’上重读哪个音节？
